scope: BrowseRefs owned canonical Merge dialog/context command and real transaction; full app/source Merge parity remains incomplete.

verification.source: BrowseRefs offers Merge with original icon before Switch for working-tree commit objects, excluding current local branch, and passes selected canonical ref to CAppUtils::Merge. Merge handler does not Refresh afterward. Menu title reads live HEAD; native Git-resolved HEAD path follows source direct admin HEAD read, including linked worktrees and detached (no branch) label. CChooseVersion maps local/remote to branch, tags to tag and other refs to commit; canonical native representation retained.
verification.native_route: New private hidden shipping-controller receiver passes Apple and bundled Git: original menu/icon/Merge-before-Switch, exact native local/remote/symbolic HEAD/light tag/notes and packed NFC/NFD presets, same repository/config hook, live moved HEAD/current/detached/linked/type/bare gates, parent/close/Quit/competing/cancel/rejected/forced-initial-load cleanup. Real fast-forward merge captures selected feature despite later draft edit, changes HEAD/index/file, retains owner through native progress acknowledgement and releases once.
verification.factory: Standalone Merge callbacks extracted unchanged to configureMergeInteractions; browser factory and inherited remote-only tracking configuration use it. Receiver captures hook but does not construct RepositoryModel because it writes shared Finder settings. Merge hosting/message history/progress inherit private preference store.
verification.core: Fifteen ReferenceBrowserTests/MergeTests pass with both Git engines.
verification.history_regression: Existing private native Merge history/menu/editor/failure/default/no-commit/Saved Data receiver passes both engines.
verification.switch_regression: Existing browser-owned Switch route/transaction/policy/cancellation/forced stage receiver passes both engines after browser menu and HEAD-path changes.
verification.cycles: Zero AttributeGraph cycle warnings in all three final native logs.
